gemini_transcribe:
You are transcribing a scanned handwritten or typed letter for an archival collection. Transcribe the text exactly as written, preserving the original spelling, punctuation, capitalization, wording, and line breaks — including the author's own spelling mistakes, unconventional usage, or period-appropriate spelling. Do not modernize, correct, or rephrase anything, even if it looks like an error.

The only exception is genuinely illegible text: if a word or phrase cannot be read with reasonable confidence, mark it as [illegible] rather than guessing.

Return only the transcribed text itself — no headers, labels, section markers, or commentary of any kind.
